results.title: Expense Policy
results.heading: Contractor expenses
results.text: Contractors may claim travel costs only when pre-approved in writing by their manager. No other expenses are reimbursable for contractors.

results.title: Expense Policy
results.heading: Limits
results.text: Client meals may cost up to $120 per person. A director must approve any client meal over $500 in total.

results.title: Remote and Hybrid Work Policy
results.heading: Working abroad
results.text: Employees may work from a country other than their country of employment for up to 30 days in a calendar year, with prior approval from HR.

results.title: IT Security Policy
results.heading: Personal phones
results.text: Personal phones may access company email only through the managed mail app.

results.title: Leave Policy
results.heading: Bereavement leave
results.text: Employees may take up to 5 paid days for the death of an immediate family member and up to 2 paid days for other relatives.
